explication: NeMo Speech is a PyTorch toolkit for building and running speech and audio models, including ASR, TTS, and speech LLMs. A representative user workflow is to configure a streaming ASR request, select a buffered or cache-aware pipeline, process audio into transcript segments, and optionally normalize or translate the text. The tree also shows model/data/training components, audio-to-audio work, and a real-time voice-agent integration. README capabilities guide the high-level branches; only the sampled inference and voice-agent code supports detailed wiring, so other relationships are intentionally limited.
